description: The arena for recording battles as training data for a neural network (user, 30.09.2026): the empty flat map MP Crossroads (flat), each side a lord, 4 spearmen and 2 archers of the Empire, the armies 350 m apart (two bow ranges). The game's AI fights itself (one side attacks, the other defends; ours through CA's script AI planner) and every unit of both sides is recorded every second (src/entries/nn_arena.lua). Positions: forward is towards the enemy, lateral to the right of the facing; the army's centre (its spearmen's front) stands gap_m/2 from the map's centre.
